correctness.rationale: Variance bounds distance from [0,1]^n to O(P) by sqrt(floor(n²/4)/n). Coordinatewise strict convexity forces every bound-attainer to be balanced binary. Constant-vector projection has comparability normal cone and exactly the balanced Hall transport condition by nonnegative flow and max-flow/min-cut; even n is perfect matching. Chain positive-prefix sums give Catalan and coprime cycle-lemma counts; alternating fence has one corner via directed nonnegative Hasse flow. Independent enumeration n=2..10 confirms counts 1,2,2,4,5,10,14,28,42; source rational checker n<=12 inspected.
